feeds.description: My journey to finding freedom from my eating disorder. I'm a 29-year-old living in the midwest. My goal to keep this account as authentic as possible, and some things I write about may surprise you. But I believe you're only as sick as your secrets, and this has been my biggest secret for nearly 16 years. So here goes nothing.
